description: Synthetic text fixture for R33-T039: Test an input perturbation (Encoder-Decoder / Text Interface Robustness). Six fictional text records used as a pipeline verification fixture. NOT observations from any real corpus.

robustness_properties.valid_transformation: Record-order permutation with stable IDs preserves ID-aligned predictions; whitespace and casing normalization preserves tokenization.
robustness_properties.fallback_property: Unseen tokens map explicitly to '<unk>' fallback token (ID 1).
robustness_properties.rejection_property: Missing 'text' or 'record_id' fields and non-string inputs are rejected with ValueError.

data_contract.source: Fully synthetic — generated for text interface perturbation verification only
data_contract.disclaimer: These records are simulated. Results must not be cited as evidence of real-world or clinical performance.
